newsitem.title: UK: W H Smith slightly higher after results.
newsitem.headline: W H Smith slightly higher after results.

text.p: Shares in W H Smith Group Plc edged higher in pre-market trade on Wednesday after the company said it made an annual pretax loss of 194.7 million stg.
The shares were up 1-1/2p to 517p by 0720 GMT, reflecting analysts' caution ahead of a results briefing from the company.
Pre-exceptional pretax profits for the year to June 1996 came in at 98.8 million stg compared with 114.5 million stg a year ago.
Analysts had been forecasting pre-exceptional profits of between 75 million and 87 million stg. But they said the number of exceptional items had clouded the picture.

"The clean figure, as reported, is obviously much better than we expected, but the statement on current trading was not that bullish," said a spokesman for broker Mees Pierson. "It's indicative they haven't given any like-for-like sales figures."
W H Smith described sales performance in the current year as "patchy" but a final dividend of 10.4p was maintained.
Mees Pierson is unlikely to revise its profit forecast for next year, which stands at 115-120 million stg.
"We've been a seller of the shares for the past few weeks and we still think they're overvalued," the spokesman said.
